name: curved-wall-opening
description: Verifies openings on curved walls (PARITY-CURVEDWALL v2). Loads a custom plan, curves a wall, places a window on it at mid-arc (arc-length offset), asserts the opening persisted, and renders the 3D shell (the per-chord opening cut + arc-positioned glass mount without error).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: add-window-on-arc
steps.eval: import('/src/floorplan/wallArc.ts').then(m => { const st = window.__store.getState(); const w = st.floorPlan.walls.find(x => x.id === window.__wallId); const L = m.wallArcLength(w); const width = Math.min(1.2, L * 0.4); st.addOpening({ kind: 'window', wallId: window.__wallId, offset: L/2 - width/2, width, sill: 0.95, head: 2.1 }); })

steps.name: verify-opening
steps.failMessage: window opening was not added to the curved wall
